trigger: irreversible operations (drop writes, run-state) + cross-plugin path (orchestrator.py) + golden-freeze conversion

doubts.claim_under_doubt: every scenario through driver_cli equals its frozen trace, so behaviour is preserved
doubts.disproof_attempt: driver_cli.py and test_driver_cli.py are not in REQUIRED (test_trace_freeze.py:35-84); the mapping that turns CLI JSON back into trace fields can be edited by any later unit with no delta, and no seeded regression shows the CLI comparison can fail
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: repin with driver_cli.py and test_driver_cli.py in REQUIRED (or record it as a P4 obligation) and add one seeded regression through CliDriver

doubts.disproof_attempt: fallback entries are appended only on the real run (release_aggregate.py:38-40); the old prose and the frozen replay appended them before the dry run, so the preview named them; now an operator approves a preview that never mentions them; no frozen scenario combines dry run and fallback
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: show the pending fallback bullets in the dry run, or record this as a named approved behaviour change

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the SKILL.md A1 delta only turns steps into calls
doubts.disproof_attempt: the aggregate_decisions.py --dry-run ADR-number preview was deleted and the CLI has no replacement
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: have aggregate --dry-run return the ADR numbers it would assign, or state the removal explicitly

doubts.claim_under_doubt: each page that needs an action gets exactly one upgrade-note drop
doubts.disproof_attempt: _has_drop globs '{id}_*.md', so a.md is seen as done once a_b.md's drop exists; the flattened path makes x/y.md collide with x-y.md; the status reads action_drop_exists and the note is silently lost
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: match '^{id}_\d{3}\.md$', make the id unique per page path, add a test

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the gate policy has one source (C1)
doubts.disproof_attempt: release_gates.answers re-derives the rule from the raw policy plus its own mode/autonomy logic and ignores the resolver's effective_policy/should_stop

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the prose is consistent with the stored-date default
doubts.disproof_attempt: rerunning-a-release.md:44-47 still says the default is today and to pass --release-date, while SKILL.md says pass no date
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: one line plus an approved delta

doubts.claim_under_doubt: orchestrator_path finds the right orchestrator in every layout
doubts.disproof_attempt: the mirror tree is tried before the installed version; the highest version wins without matching this plugin's version or skipping orphaned copies
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: prefer the same version, skip orphans, test the mirror-plus-installed layout

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the run state belongs to one release
doubts.disproof_attempt: the state is keyed per git directory, not per project root; two projects in one checkout releasing the same version share run id and date
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: key on the project root too, or rebut

summary: 8 doubts (2 medium, 2 low-medium, 4 low). Main ones: the CLI comparison harness is not frozen, and fallback bullets drop out of the preview. None blocks the commit; disposition: carried into P4 as a closed fix list.
